## User problem

What work are you trying to complete, and what is missing today?

## Proposed workflow

Show the intended inputs, commands, and outputs. Identify which evidence would make the result useful.

## Validation

How should the change be tested? If it affects economic comparisons, specify the task support, cost basis, missing-data behavior, and trust boundary.

## Alternatives

Which existing tools or workflows have you considered?
